column1: # Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# The player's own profile for this fork (the game has none upstream): the memory values are still the survey's provisional ones, not checked by hand.
# Played on the Xiaomi 23117RK66C (Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, Adreno 750, Android 16): with the online SDK loaded the game boots to its logo screen and runs at 60 fps
# (2026-11-23). The intro video's context crashes now and then - a null in the game's own Mono lookup, not in the host; the two runs of that evening loaded it
# fine - so the game is experimental until that is settled (see the case file).
# DM_ONLINE_SDK=1 lets the host load the game's Epic Online Services NRO (hle_ro.c); without it the game crashes at its start-up (a null online object).
